keyPoints.en: Renewable: forests, water, soil, fish, solar energy. Non-renewable: petroleum, natural gas, tin, bauxite, coal, gold.
keyPoints.bm: Boleh baharu: hutan, air, tanih, ikan, tenaga suria. Tidak boleh baharu: petroleum, gas asli, bijih timah, bauksit, arang batu, emas.

keyPoints.en: Petroleum and gas offshore Terengganu, Sarawak, Sabah (first oil well: Miri, 1910; LNG: Bintulu). Tin: Kinta Valley. Bauxite: Kuantan. Coal: Sarawak, Sabah. Gold: Raub, Bau.
keyPoints.bm: Petroleum dan gas di luar pantai Terengganu, Sarawak, Sabah (telaga minyak pertama: Miri, 1910; LNG: Bintulu). Bijih timah: Lembah Kinta. Bauksit: Kuantan. Arang batu: Sarawak, Sabah. Emas: Raub, Bau.

keyPoints.en: Export income, jobs, raw materials for industry, energy supply and funds for infrastructure; avoid depending on one resource.
keyPoints.bm: Pendapatan eksport, pekerjaan, bahan mentah industri, bekalan tenaga dan dana infrastruktur; elakkan kebergantungan kepada satu sumber.
